描述_EN: the intricate floral pattern was created by building up many layers of lacquer and then carving them. the filtered and purified lacquer was then applied to a base, usually of wood, and coloured. lacquer was a craft from east asia. the red colour of this early 15th-century bowlstand was achieved by using cinnabar as a colouring agent. chinese workers had been tapping the sap of the lacquer tree from about 3000 bc.
描述_ZN: 复杂的花卉图案是由许多层漆堆积而成的，然后进行雕刻。 经过过滤和净化的漆被涂在底座上，通常是木头的，然后上色。 漆器是一种来自东亚的工艺。 这个15世纪早期的碗架的红色是通过使用朱砂作为着色剂实现的。 中国工人从公元前3000年起就开始采掘漆树的汁液。
